enhancedPrompt.productVision: To create a comprehensive and intuitive dashboard that enables educators, system leaders, and policymakers to monitor and improve student outcomes, system leadership impact, institutional effectiveness, and school community participation through unified frameworks and actionable insights.
enhancedPrompt.targetUsers: Educators, school administrators, system leaders, policymakers, and education stakeholders.
personas: School Principal: Focused on improving student outcomes and school infrastructure.
District Education Officer: Interested in system-wide improvements and policy changes.
Education Policy Maker: Concerned with scaling successful programs and institutionalizing best practices.
userStories: As a school principal, I want to view student attendance rates so I can identify trends and implement retention strategies.
As a district education officer, I need to see budget utilization reports to ensure resources are allocated effectively.
As a policy maker, I want to track policy adoption rates to measure the impact of new guidelines.
As a system leader, I need to monitor leadership behavior indicators to drive continuous improvement.
As an educator, I want to access student learning outcomes to tailor my teaching methods.
userFlows: User logs in and is directed to the Home Dashboard.
User navigates to the Student Outcomes Overview to view enrollment and retention rates.
User generates a custom report on system leader impact and exports it for a meeting.
enhancedPrompt.architecture: Microservices architecture with a RESTful API backend and a React-based frontend.
enhancedPrompt.database: Relational database (PostgreSQL) for structured data storage and analytics.
uxRequirements: Responsive design for access on various devices.
technicalRequirements: Scalable backend to handle large datasets.
Integration with third-party data sources via APIs.
edgeCases: Data source API fails, leading to incomplete data visualization.
User attempts to access unauthorized data, triggering a security alert.
High traffic causes slow loading times for the dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: All core features are implemented and functional.
Dashboard loads within 3 seconds under normal conditions.
User role-based access control is correctly enforced.
successMetrics: Average session duration of at least 10 minutes.
Reduction in dropout rates by 15% within one year.
risks: Data privacy breaches compromising sensitive information.
Technical debt leading to future scalability issues.

prd.title: Comprehensive Education Dashboard PRD
prd.overview: This PRD outlines the development of a comprehensive and intuitive dashboard designed to enable educators, system leaders, and policymakers to monitor and improve student outcomes, system leadership impact, institutional effectiveness, and school community participation through unified frameworks and actionable insights.
goals: Enhance student outcomes through actionable insights
Improve system leadership impact with real-time analytics
Increase institutional effectiveness via customizable reports
Boost school community participation through interactive data visualization
prd.targetAudience: Educators, school administrators, system leaders, policymakers, and education stakeholders

userPersonas.name: Principal John
painPoints: Lack of real-time data on student performance
Difficulty in identifying trends for retention strategies
behaviors: Regularly reviews student attendance and performance reports
Implements retention strategies based on data insights

userPersonas.name: Officer Maria
painPoints: Challenges in tracking policy adoption rates
behaviors: Tracks policy adoption rates to measure impact

userPersonas.name: Policy Maker Alex
painPoints: Difficulty in measuring the impact of new guidelines
Lack of comprehensive data on policy adoption
behaviors: Uses data to institutionalize best practices

features.description: Provides interactive charts and graphs for data analysis

features.description: Offers real-time data analysis and insights

features.description: Ensures users have access to relevant data based on their roles

features.name: Integration with External Data Sources
features.description: Integrates with external databases and systems for comprehensive data analysis
